title: Mountain Peak Reverie (3D Relief)
description: Heavy impasto textural landscape depicting rugged Himalayan ridges with layered marble dust paste, cobalt shadows, and warm gold sunrise glazes.

title: Riverbank Twilight Serenade
description: Multi-layered water vistas featuring gentle river ripples and atmospheric twilight reflections sculpted with translucent acrylic glazes.

title: Golden Horizon Sunset
description: Warm amber, terracotta, and crimson sunset gradients capturing the atmospheric glow over rolling delta horizons with sculpted cloud formations.

title: Chromatic Dimensions & Abstract Form
description: Intersecting geometric waves and organic texture peaks created through knife carving, plaster layering, and subtle metallic undertones.

title: Alpine Solitude in Winter
description: Snow-capped crystalline crags sculpted with heavy stucco paste, titanium white peaks, and deep ultramarine crevasse shadows.

title: Verdant Woodland Sanctuary
description: Tactile forest canopy rendered with deep emerald greens, raw umber bark reliefs, and textured moss layers that react dynamically to ambient lighting.

title: Celestial Starry Nightscape
description: Swirling midnight blue galaxies, starry constellations, and glowing lunar textures sculpted with dimensional paste and iridescent mineral highlights.

title: Terra & Geological Strata
description: Tactile exploration of natural stone formations and soil textures created with fine silica sand, raw pigment washes, and sculpted structural paste.
